heading: Fifteen years of gentle, advanced care
body: Fernwood Animal Hospital opened in 2011 with a simple belief: outstanding medicine and genuine warmth aren't a trade-off. Today our AAHA-accredited hospital blends digital diagnostics, in-house surgery and dentistry, and a fear-free approach with the kind of unhurried attention every pet — and every pet parent — deserves.

mission.title: Mission
mission.text: Deliver compassionate, evidence-based care that keeps pets healthy at every life stage.

vision.title: Vision
vision.text: Be the most trusted animal hospital in the region — for pets, and the people who love them.

values.title: Values
values.text: Empathy first, honest communication, and never rushing a decision that matters.
